purpose: Deterministik 9 bosqichli fikrlash va moslashuvchan chuqurlik (L1/L2/L3) boshqaruvi
responsibilities: Vazifa murakkabligiga ko'ra fikrlash chuqurligini (L1/L2/L3) belgilash
Kod yozishdan oldin majburiy parchalash va xavf tahlilini majburlash
Truth Engine bilan ClaimID havola zanjirini o'rnatishtirish
Ishonch darajasini (Confidence Score) hisoblash va 0.70 chegarasini majburlash

guarantees.reasoning_before_action: Analiz bajarilmasdan turib kod generatsiyasi boshlanmaydi
guarantees.confidence_gate: Ishonch darajasi 0.70 dan past bo'lganda ijro bloklanadi
guarantees.truth_binding: L2/L3 fikrlashdagi har bir taxmin ClaimID ga biriktiriladi

failure_modes: UNBOUND_ASSUMPTION: Taxmin Truth Engine ClaimID ga biriktirilmagan
DEPTH_MISMATCH: Vazifa murakkabligiga mos kelmaydigan chuqurlik tanlangan
